A second compatible reading is that the contract is a generic state-action requirement while the lifecycle phase is unspecified; that scope distinction remains because the dossier supplies no exact entry, do, or exit requirement. semantic_adjudication.reason: The NL3 clause requires EmergencyStopping to send the "Obstacle Detected" signal. The exact source binding and closed model identify a SendObstacleDetected lifecycle action in EmergencyStopping. Although no transition effect with that signal is supplied, the dossier explicitly places the carrier on state lifecycle behavior rather than on a transition effect.
